nodes.label: Date-Time description
nodes.description: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of year, month, day properties restricted to corresponding XML Schema types xsd:gYear, xsd:gMonth and xsd:gDay, respectively.

nodes.label: Date-time interval
nodes.description: DateTimeInterval is a subclass of ProperInterval, defined using the multi-element DateTimeDescription.

nodes.label: Day of week
nodes.description: The day of week

nodes.label: Time duration
nodes.description: Duration of a temporal extent expressed as a number scaled by a temporal unit

nodes.label: Duration description
nodes.description: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system. The temporal reference system is fixed to Gregorian Calendar, and the range of each of the numeric properties is restricted to xsd:decimal

nodes.label: Generalized date-time description
nodes.description: Description of date and time structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system

nodes.label: Generalized duration description
nodes.description: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system.

nodes.label: Time instant
nodes.description: A temporal entity with zero extent or duration

nodes.label: Time interval
nodes.description: A temporal entity with an extent or duration

nodes.label: Month of year
nodes.description: The month of the year

nodes.label: Proper interval
nodes.description: A temporal entity with non-zero extent or duration, i.e. for which the value of the beginning and end are different

nodes.label: Temporal Reference System
nodes.description:
A temporal reference system, such as a temporal coordinate system (with an origin, direction, and scale), a calendar-clock combination, or a (possibly hierarchical) ordinal system. 

This is a stub class, representing the set of all temporal reference systems.

nodes.label: Temporal duration
nodes.description: Time extent; duration of a time interval separate from its particular start position

nodes.label: Temporal entity
nodes.description: A temporal interval or instant.

nodes.label: Temporal position
nodes.description: A position on a time-line

nodes.label: Temporal unit
nodes.description: A standard duration, which provides a scale factor for a time extent, or the granularity or precision for a time position.

nodes.label: Time position
nodes.description: A temporal position described using either a (nominal) value from an ordinal reference system, or a (numeric) value in a temporal coordinate system.

nodes.label: Time Zone
nodes.description:
A Time Zone specifies the amount by which the local time is offset from UTC. 
	A time zone is usually denoted geographically (e.g. Australian Eastern Daylight Time), with a constant value in a given region. 
The region where it applies and the offset from UTC are specified by a locally recognised governing authority.

nodes.label: Year
nodes.description: Year duration

nodes.label: after
nodes.description: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is after another temporal entity T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

nodes.label: before
nodes.description: Gives directionality to time. If a temporal entity T1 is before another temporal entity T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2. Thus, "before" can be considered to be basic to instants and derived for intervals.

nodes.label: day
nodes.description:
Day position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar day from any calendar.

nodes.label: day of week
nodes.description: The day of week, whose value is a member of the class time:DayOfWeek

nodes.label: day of year
nodes.description: The number of the day within the year

nodes.label: days duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in days

nodes.label: has beginning
nodes.description: Beginning of a temporal entity

nodes.label: has Date-Time description
nodes.description: Value of DateTimeInterval expressed as a structured value. The beginning and end of the interval coincide with the limits of the shortest element in the description.

nodes.label: has duration
nodes.description: Duration of a temporal entity, expressed as a scaled value or nominal value

nodes.label: has duration description
nodes.description: Duration of a temporal entity, expressed using a structured description

nodes.label: has end
nodes.description: End of a temporal entity.

nodes.label: Temporal reference system used
nodes.description: The temporal reference system used by a temporal position or extent description.

nodes.label: has temporal duration
nodes.description: Duration of a temporal entity.

nodes.label: has time
nodes.description: Supports the association of a temporal entity (instant or interval) to any thing

nodes.label: has XSD duration
nodes.description: Extent of a temporal entity, expressed using xsd:duration

nodes.label: hour
nodes.description: Hour position in a calendar-clock system.

nodes.label: hours duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in hours

nodes.label: in date-time description
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using a structured description

nodes.label: Temporal position
nodes.description: Position of a time instant

nodes.label: Time position
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed as a temporal coordinate or nominal value

nodes.label: in XSD date
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:date

nodes.label: in XSD Date-Time
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:dateTime

nodes.label: in XSD Date-Time-Stamp
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:dateTimeStamp

nodes.label: in XSD g-Year
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:gYear

nodes.label: in XSD g-YearMonth
nodes.description: Position of an instant, expressed using xsd:gYearMonth

nodes.label: has time instant inside
nodes.description: An instant that falls inside the interval. It is not intended to include beginnings and ends of intervals.

nodes.label: interval after
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalAfter another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval before
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalBefore another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2.

nodes.label: interval contains
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalContains another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval disjoint
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDisjoint another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the end of T2, or the end of T1 is before the beginning of T2, i.e. the intervals do not overlap in any way, but their ordering relationship is not known.

nodes.label: interval during
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalDuring another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval equals
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalEquals another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval finished by
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval finishes
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalFinishes another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval in
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalIn another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2 or is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2, or is coincident with the end of T2, except that end of T1 may not be coincident with the end of T2 if the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

nodes.label: interval meets
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMeets another proper interval T2, then the end of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2.

nodes.label: interval met by
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalMetBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval overlapped by
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlappedBy another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is after the beginning of T2, the beginning of T1 is before the end of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval overlaps
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalOverlaps another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is before the beginning of T2, the end of T1 is after the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval started by
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarted another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is after the end of T2.

nodes.label: interval starts
nodes.description: If a proper interval T1 is intervalStarts another proper interval T2, then the beginning of T1 is coincident with the beginning of T2, and the end of T1 is before the end of T2.

nodes.label: minute
nodes.description: Minute position in a calendar-clock system.

nodes.label: minutes
nodes.description: length, or element of, a temporal extent expressed in minutes

nodes.label: month
nodes.description:
Month position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar month from any calendar.

nodes.label: month of year
nodes.description: The month of the year, whose value is a member of the class time:MonthOfYear

nodes.label: months duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in months

nodes.label: Name of temporal position
nodes.description: The (nominal) value indicating temporal position in an ordinal reference system

nodes.label: Numeric value of temporal duration
nodes.description: Value of a temporal extent expressed as a decimal number scaled by a temporal unit

nodes.label: Numeric value of temporal position
nodes.description: The (numeric) value indicating position within a temporal coordinate system

nodes.label: second
nodes.description: Second position in a calendar-clock system.

nodes.label: seconds duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in seconds

nodes.label: in time zone
nodes.description: The time zone for clock elements in the temporal position

nodes.label: temporal unit type
nodes.description: The temporal unit which provides the precision of a date-time value or scale of a temporal extent

nodes.label: week
nodes.description: Week number within the year.

nodes.label: weeks duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in weeks

nodes.label: has XSD date-time
nodes.description: Value of DateTimeInterval expressed as a compact value.

nodes.label: year
nodes.description:
Year position in a calendar-clock system.

The range of this property is not specified, so can be replaced by any specific representation of a calendar year from any calendar.

nodes.label: years duration
nodes.description: length of, or element of the length of, a temporal extent expressed in years
